pages.text: The ultimate combination of $(thing)Rapid Fire$() and $(thing)Scatter Shot$(). Hold $(thing)Shift$() with a fully drawn bow to unleash a continuous volley of arrow fans at high speed.$(br2)Each volley fires multiple arrows in an arc and costs soul energy accordingly. Extremely effective at saturating an area with damage, but drains your soul reserves rapidly.

pages.title: Unlocking
pages.text: Place the Soul Bow in a crafting table with $(bold)three$() $(item)Arrows$() and a $(item)Crossbow$() to begin the forging task.$(br2)Like Rapid Fire, this task requires sustained damage within a tight time window, but at a higher threshold. Check the tooltip for details.$(br2)By default, the damage interval shouldn't be longer than one second.
